Definition: plain, Sharon, the name of a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Sharon is a plain, the level land between the mountains and the sea, and the place where the Gadites dwelt in Bashan. Isaiah says the excellency of Carmel and Sharon shall be given to the wilderness when it blossoms, and the Song says, I am the rose of Sharon, and the lily of the valleys.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Sharon preaches that the plain can blossom. The wilderness shall see the glory of the LORD, and the rose of Sharon grows where no one planted a garden, and I hold that God makes deserts bloom.
